_comment: Written by scripts/deprecations/generate_removals.py at release-prep. Cumulative; prior entries are never rewritten. Records with a deprecated_in version are detected from tag history, so do not edit them. Records with deprecated_in null are drafts for modules moved or removed without a deprecation: review and fix them by hand in the release PR. A rerun never overwrites an existing record.

removals.subject: LmntTTSService.language
removals.message: Use ``settings=LmntTTSService.Settings(language=...)`` instead. Will be removed in 2.0.0.

removals.subject: LmntTTSService.model

removals.subject: LmntTTSService.voice_id

removals.subject: PipecatToneReader
removals.message: `PipecatToneReader` moved to `pipecat.expressive.processors.tone_reader` in 1.16.0; the old `pipecat.processors.tone.reader` path was removed without a deprecation period.

removals.subject: pipecat.processors.tone
removals.message: `pipecat.processors.tone` was removed in 1.16.0 without a deprecation period. Its contents moved to `pipecat.classifiers.tone.model`, `pipecat.expressive.processors.tone_reader`, `pipecat.expressive.processors.tone_tagger`, `pipecat.expressive.processors.tone_tagger.model`.

removals.message: `HumeTTSService` is deprecated since 1.16.0 and will be removed in 2.0.0. No replacement. Hume shuts down its TTS API on November 13, 2026.
